systems.owner: Bureau national d'état civil (BUNEC), with UNDP, GIZ and Korean cooperation in named communes
systems.tiers: 60 of 432 principal civil registration centres digitised since 2020 (13.9%), per BUNEC's director-general on 14 September 2026; 42 in April 2022, among them eight municipalities of Yaoundé and Douala and 28 other communes

note: A September 2026 report on the funding sought to digitise civil registration: it counts centres whose records are digitised, an application, and states nothing about how a commune's office is connected.
